_comment: Minimum LINE coverage (%) per module and for the merged total, enforced by scripts/coverage-summary.py in CI.
Floors = floor(measured) - 1, from CI run #53 on 72624c7 (2026-09-23), after the test-review pass.

notification glue) with no unit tests yet; raise their floors as pure logic is extracted and tested.
Only ever raise a floor, or lower it with a reason in the commit message. See docs/testing.md.
